name: Tasting menu at NAAR, Kasauli: we drive, you dine
description: NAAR is Chef Prateek Sadhu's restaurant in the hills above Kasauli, cooking Himalayan-forward food through the seasons. A long tasting menu deserves a slow evening and a glass of wine, and nobody should have to drive the hill road after that. We book the car, you book the table, and we bring you home.
steps:
Pickup at your door — A driver who knows the Kasauli road, timed to your table.
Up into the hills — Stop for tea or a view on the way if you like.
Your table at NAAR — Take your time. The driver waits.
Home to bed — Back at your Apricot home, however late it runs.
included:
Private car and driver, both ways
Fuel, tolls and parking
Waiting time at NAAR
Help getting your table
thingsToKnow:
Tables — NAAR books out. Ask us early. Closed Mondays.
The road — Hill road with bends. Tell us if anyone gets carsick.
priceNote: Meal and drinks paid directly to NAAR
